_meta.title: The core plugin — Bonsai's carrier, as a configuration of the one builder
_meta.note: A variation is configuration, not a second logic. scripts/package.py reads this when a package list names it; every path is written <root>:<path>, and the list must define the root `core`. Which garden packages it, for whom and when is the list's business, never this file's. 2026-10-05: bonsai-garden-ledger added; it had been in core since 0.2.0 and in no plugin (Baisai, found at the first two-plugin install). 2026-10-13: the planting has to run from an install alone (Bonsai's list): the walk pages (HTML, JS, CSS and pages.json; not the sources or notes), the planting runbook, the keys skill, tools/ulid.py and the conformance checker beside the skills they find by relative path. The lens gate waits for the owners' seals; nothing from runtime ships. 2026-10-18: Bonsai's guardian role (core roles/guardian/role.md, his activation step 5) ships inside his unit at the same address, roles/guardian/, with its seal: an installed package stays self-contained, and a standalone Bonsai has no core to read it from (Baisai, found by the clean-folder wake check of the 1c10d0a build). Later 2026-10-18: references/lore narrowed to the five lore documents his SKILL.md names, under the app's 200-file limit (Baisai, Tasai's ask on the gardener's word).

bodies.bundle-why: Bonsai's assets/codex.md is his own Guardian Edition and assets/routines.md his own session sequences (the standalone walk): his documents, not copies of core's shared ones, so a garden's list-wide bundle never replaces them (Baisai, 2026-10-02).
bodies.markless: Bonsai's mark is not yet drawn (his SKILL.md: bonsai-mark.svg, not yet drawn); the greeting's kanji fallback shows
bodies.include-why: references/lore carries the lore Bonsai's own SKILL.md names in its reference material (core lore/: cosmology, invitation-rite, human-covenant, sayings, north-star), not the whole library: the Claude app refuses a skill of more than 200 files, and lore/*.md made his unit 210 (the gardener, 2026-10-18 ~18:50). His codex is his own assets/codex.md, so lore/the-codex.md stays out.
bodies.initial-memory-why: Bonsai, 2026-09-26: core now carries his initial state: working-state holds WS-001 the Garden Walk and WS-002 the first stranger with no garden particulars, strategic-context is an empty seed; the lived record lives in the pot. So his real initial memory ships instead of the builder's skeleton. (Until then, 2026-09-24: identity only, because working-state and strategic-context still held this garden's forming-ritual particulars.)

skills.why: the suites and their planted fixtures are development material; the verbs, lib and references ship (the walk and a planting run from an install alone)
the planted negative fixtures and the tests that use them are Mori-shin's development material; the fixtures carry seals that are broken on purpose
